name: anti-rea
description: Anti-REA: a defensive release-assurance engine. Inventories what a build actually ships, detects declared server-only secrets that leaked into the distribution, checks asset placement, records evidence with explicit result states, and enforces hard release gates.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node fixtures/demo-app/build-release.mjs vulnerable && node build/src/cli.js assure --manifest fixtures/demo-app/manifest.json --policy fixtures/demo-app/policy.json --authz-results fixtures/demo-app/authz-results.vulnerable.json --out build/demo-report/vulnerable
scripts.demo:fixed: npm run build && node fixtures/demo-app/build-release.mjs fixed && node build/src/cli.js assure --manifest fixtures/demo-app/manifest.json --policy fixtures/demo-app/policy.json --authz-results fixtures/demo-app/authz-results.fixed.json --out build/demo-report/fixed
